editorial.title: Agent platforms consolidate while buyers push for provable ROI
editorial.body: The frontier labs are converging on agentic workflows as the enterprise battleground, and platform vendors are racing to bundle orchestration, governance and evaluation into one contract. Buyers hold more leverage than the headlines suggest: model quality gaps are narrowing quarter on quarter, switching costs remain manageable at the application layer, and the delivery channel (the systems integrators below) is competing hard on AI readiness. The disciplined move this quarter is to price that leverage into every renewal conversation.

questions: Which model providers are strongest in regulated industries?
